blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Most Filipinos believe they can protect themselves from scams but are still “absolutely worried” about being scammed, a new consumer report showed. Dr. Alicor Panao, Inquirer data scientist and associate professor at the University of the Philippines, said that based on the GSMA 2026 Consumer Scam Report for Southeast Asia, “Filipinos stand out for both their confidence and their anxiety.” Some 87% rated their ability to protect themselves from scams highly, the highest among the six markets, compared with 86% in Indonesia, 80% in Thailand, 78% in Malaysia, 68% in Vietnam and 65% in Singapore.
